t: A free Scala learning environment for drawing, animation, music, games, and Arduino.
steps: Download the desktop app from the Kogics site, or open ikojo.in in a browser.
Ask IT to install the desktop app if needed.
Draw a square with a few lines of code.
Try the turtle and picture graphics.
Use the tracing tool to follow a program.
Test the web app on Chromebooks before you plan a lesson.
Add an Arduino board only if you want circuit projects.
